source.name: Sports Business Journal — Pelicans sign NewAge Products as patch partner
source.quote: NewAge Products, a Toronto-based DTC seller of modular storage systems and outdoor kitchens, is the Pelicans new ad patch sponsor.
source.note: Zoomph's NBA patch guide (updated 2026-08-11) lists NewAge Products as the Pelicans' 2026/27 patch partner: https://zoomph.com/blog/nba-jersey-patch-sponsors-this-season/
